name: disconnected
source:
In a post-apocalyptic world, you search for oxygen in order to survive outdoors. The air isn't safe anymore, after all. So you scavenge for materials... and may just make a friend along the way.

[From [url=https://stormmv.itch.io/disconnected]Itch.io[/url]]

在后世界末日的世界中，你需要寻找氧气才能在户外生存。毕竟空气不再安全了。所以你会寻找材料……并且可能会一路上结交朋友。
